name: PlayerController
description: Turns a player's input into intent. One exists per player and outlives the character it drives. A level selects its player controller in World Settings.

methods.name: on_possess
methods.doc: Called when the controller takes control of a character.

methods.name: on_unpossess
methods.doc: Called when the controller releases its character.

methods.name: on_input
methods.doc: Called every frame so the controller can read input and steer its character.
